content: नरः [नॄ-नये-अच्] .²1 A man, male person; संयोजयति विद्यैव नीचगापि नरं सरित् . समुद्रमिव दुर्धर्षं नृपं भाग्यमतः परम् .. <ls>H. Pr. 5</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 96</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 213</ls>. .²2 A man or piece at chess. .²3 The pin of a sun-dial. .²4 The Supreme Spirit, the original or eternal man. .²5 Manʼs length (= पुरुष. <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a primitive sage. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Arjuna; see नरनारायण below. .²8 A horse. .²9 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A personal termination. .²10 The individual soul (जीवात्मा); <ls>Mb. 12. 280. 50</ls>.
